opening.argument: The video promotes the FORSAGE BUSD plan through paid entry, additional slots, and recruitment-based returns. It states, “Register you must activate ID with 10$,” then ties X3 income to finding other players: “after our ID activation we need income from X3 slot so must find other players in this slot.” The presentation further describes buying three X3 and three X4 slots for a $70 investment, referral placements, and recycling through the matrix. Its slides visibly reinforce the structure with UPLINE and referral positions, a RECYCLE step, and displayed slot amounts and profits reaching $29,700 and $39,600. Those figures are presented as promotional projections; the records do not establish that they were realized or guaranteed.
